fixes.what: Change `srcset="... assets/img/pom-tree-night.jpg 1125w, assets/img/pom-tree-night-1400.jpg 1400w"` to match `index.html` (`800w` and `1125w` only), or ensure the 1400w file exists and has the larger intrinsic width.
fixes.why: The `img` declares `width="1125"` for `pom-tree-night.jpg` while listing a `-1400.jpg` candidate in `srcset` that is omitted on `index.html`, risking a 404 or mismatched aspect ratio on high-DPR screens.

fixes.what: Change `font-display: block` to `font-display: swap` (or `optional`) on both `@font-face` declarations.
fixes.why: Even with `<link rel="preload">`, `font-display: block` risks up to a 3-second invisible text delay (FOIT) on slow mobile 3G/4G connections before rendering critical headings.
